wins.label: Exceptional revenue acceleration
wins.evidence: Revenue grew 30% year-over-year in Q3 driven by an intensifying AI revolution...U.S. business achieved 44% year-over-year

wins.label: Strong commercial momentum with high growth rates
wins.evidence: U.S. commercial business momentum continued with 54% year-over-year and 13% sequential revenue growth...customer count grew 77% year-over-year

wins.label: Record profitability and cash generation
wins.evidence: adjusted operating margin to 38%...generated over $1 billion in adjusted free cash flow for the first time in the company's history

wins.label: Significant customer wins with rapid ROI
wins.evidence: Trinity Rail, it took just 3 months to get to a functional workflow with a $30 million impact to its bottom line

wins.label: Government business acceleration and military adoption
wins.evidence: U.S. government business revenue growth accelerated to 40% year-over-year...strongest sequential growth in 15 quarters...Army was the first military department to adopt Maven

risks.label: International commercial headwinds
risks.evidence: continued headwinds in Europe and a step down in revenue from a government-sponsored enterprise in the Middle East...7% sequential decline

risks.label: Strategic commercial contracts declining
risks.evidence: We anticipate fourth quarter 2024 revenue from these customers to decline to between $6 million to $7.5 million compared to $20 million in the fourth quarter of 2023

risks.label: Commoditization of AI models creating competitive pressure
risks.evidence: We're witnessing the commoditization of cognition with the rapid advancement of AI models...pricing for inference is dropping like a rock

risks.label: Expense growth acceleration expected
risks.evidence: We continue to expect expenses to ramp through the fourth quarter as we invest in the product pipeline

risks.label: Potential stock-based compensation acceleration
risks.evidence: we will continue to monitor if we become required to accelerate stock-based compensation expenses if certain market-based vesting criteria are achieved earlier than expected
